description: Find VERIFIED service businesses in the dfwmetro.net directory for booking. Only listings that passed human verification-desk review are returned — this tool can never surface unverified businesses and can never change verification status. Each result includes the business's booking_url plus machine-booking capability and endpoint health when known. Use booking_url for human-style booking flows; use capability endpoints only when present. Kept for backward compatibility; new integrations should prefer find_listings with verified_only:true.

inputSchema.description: Find genuinely online-bookable service businesses in the dfwmetro.net directory. Every listing is returned with its verification status labeled: VERIFIED businesses (human verification-desk reviewed) rank first and carry machine-booking capability and endpoint health; NOT_YET_VERIFIED businesses are clearly labeled — trust_level 'pending' means awaiting desk review and ranks last — and carry machine_ready:false. Pass verified_only:true for the strict VERIFIED-only shelf. Nothing here can change verification status.

trade.description: Category id from https://dfwmetro.net/categories.json, e.g. 'plumbing'. Legacy display labels ('Plumbing', 'Heating & Air Conditioning', 'Electrical') are also accepted and normalized.

verified_only.description: True returns only VERIFIED listings (the strict premium shelf); false (default) returns all listings with verification status labeled, VERIFIED ranked first.

inputSchema.title: dfwmetro.net listing discovery

name: find_verified_listings
